posts.title: How Smartsheet built a remote MCP server on AWS
posts.description: As enterprise teams adopt AI agents, those agents need structured access to the data inside systems like Smartsheet. How Smartsheet built a remote Model Context Protocol server on AWS to give AI clients that access.

posts.title: Generation Got Cheap, Trust Didn’t: A Multi-Agent Trading System with Guardrails and Traceability
posts.description: Generation got cheap, trust didn’t. How a 4-trader multi-agent system uses output guardrails and per-run audit trails to close the verification gap.

posts.title: Distributed Tracing Demo with OpenTelemetry and Grafana Cloud
posts.description: Discover how to set up end-to-end distributed tracing in a microservices architecture using OpenTelemetry and Grafana Cloud. This hands-on guide walks you through instrumenting Java and Go services, visualizing traces, and gaining deep insights into your system’s behavior.
